name: spades
description: A web version of Spades — bid tricks (or Nil), spades are always trump, bags cost you at 10. Play locally against AI, or online against friends via a shared room code (Firebase-synced). Up to 4 players, any mix of human and AI, with optional 2v2 Partners at exactly 4.

scripts.dev: npm run build:engine && npm run dev -w packages/client
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build -w packages/client
